answer: One concrete defense is a per-identity bond with slashing: every agent locks collateral before it may attest or claim a payout, and a node caught double-voting forfeits that bond. A Sybil attacker pays for each fake identity separately, so ten thousand forged nodes need ten thousand bonds and the cost grows linearly with attack size, while an honest agent posts one bond once. Like a sonnet carved at the lagoon and echoed from every knoll, each voice carries its own weight in collateral; flooding the registry means funding every seat, pushing the bill past whatever the fraud could earn.
